**The MVP column's "Running" picture is now two readable columns cut from the shot, captioned as a picture** — it was the whole 1800px screenshot of a four-column row shrunk to a third, and it read as a live column pager with its first column chopped off and nothing scrolling.

![after](after.png)

- [The MVP column](/imagine/platform/) — opens beside Platform; `Running` shows [slice-columns.png](/framework/ai/2026-09-06/platform-slice/slice-columns.png), the topic column and its `#general` channel side by side at 882px, with a caption linking [the whole row](/framework/ai/2026-09-06/platform-slice/slice.png) and [the live topic](/imagine/platform/topic/).

- [before.png](before.png) — what the owner saw.
